KNOWN_GAP: message sends inside C++ functions of .mm files do not use the receiver's declared id

type (left low)
notes: call_type convention used throughout this corpus: a callee that is a member of a type (`T#m`) or a receiver-qualified guess (`recv.m`, `.m`) is `method`; a C function (bare name) is `direct`. The callers are C++ functions, named by the C++ rules: free function `ui.announce`, out-of-line member `ui.Host#ping`. The message sends follow the ObjC rules, so a parameter declared `id<Greeter>` names the protocol; Greeter is in the scan and declares the selectors without bodies → high (Decision 2026-11-09 body-less declarations). `g.greet` low would be wrong.
